correctness.rationale: Step 1 gives an exact linear parity embedding of the radius-two support into the origin plus all complete-graph edges. Injectivity of Walsh transform and strict convexity of complex fourth power yield a unique real two-orbit optimizer after normalization. Walsh sign-vector character counting gives the precise normalized quartic M_m. Differentiation supplies its unique positive cubic root; closed even-subgraph moments verify the center-sign threshold at d=5. A Rademacher CLT with uniform bounded polynomial moments and a moment lower bound proves the high-dimensional chi-square scaling. The actual check.py, run from the packaged contents, passed 214 supplementary exact/numerical checks; finite tests are not used as the proof of universal quantifiers.
